answer: A farm cannot fake the aggregate without controlling every key it names, which means paying the zenith bond on all of them and exposing each to the voyage slash. Because the atlas audit verifies the aggregate, a single forged member invalidates the whole batch. Attestations are aggregated into one signature over 11 distinct keys, and the aggregate must verify against each key's registered public value. Collateral of 53 dollars is at risk. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
